note: Re-audit pool for never-locked WILL. LB ROLE CONVENTION (t46u): every off-ball linebacker is assigned to exactly one of MIKE/WILL/SAM by his primary 2025-26 role = snap-weighted share of nflverse depth-chart snapshots: Base 4-3 MLB -> MIKE, WLB -> WILL, SLB -> SAM; Base 3-4 RILB (strong-side inside LB) -> MIKE, LILB (weak-side inside LB) -> WILL; 3-4 WLB/SLB are edge rushers (LEDGE/REDGE lists). Each season's slot shares are weighted by that season's nflverse defensive snaps; largest share wins (tie -> MIKE, then WILL). Players are matched by gsis/PFR id, not name. Each player appears in one list only. Players from the shared MIKE/WILL/SAM pool whose primary role is another LB spot are excluded as OTHER_POSITION; role-screen contenders added. PROPOSED for commissioner approval. Composite is a triage order, not a rating.
